evidence_against.relevance: Alex behaves warmly toward several group members and also makes one-on-one plans with other friends, weakening the inference that this behavior is special.
There has been no explicit romantic framing, romantic physical contact, or statement of romantic interest.
Postponing dinner twice without proposing a replacement date weakens the case for active special or romantic pursuit.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Two initiated one-on-one plans could indicate special interest, but are also consistent with friendship.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing preferred tea show personalized attention.
Repeated extended conversations after group events suggest sustained interest in Jordan specifically.

recommended_action.explanation: Because the personalized attention and the friendship-consistent counterevidence are closely balanced, direct clarification would resolve the ambiguity more reliably than inference.

uncertainty_explanation: C1-F1 through C1-F3 support possible special interest, while C1-F4 shows similar friendliness toward others and C1-F5 through C1-F6 provide no clear romantic escalation. Neither interpretation is sufficiently better supported.
